title: fix(news): record 3D and realtime models for model news
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The model-news pipeline now records 3D and realtime models alongside the five existing catalog categories, covering the three 3D and five realtime models previously omitted from snapshots. A newly recorded category triggers a snapshot even if the models in older categories have not changed. Weekly model posts now recognize both categories for additions, removals, access changes and price changes; 3D price comparisons use image tokens, while realtime comparisons use audio tokens or, when absent, prompt-audio seconds. The post prompts also gain category labels and emojis for both.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden newsroom, Polli pins a little 3D cube and microphone beside the existing model cards on a lime green (#ecf874) noticeboard, with code-plants growing below. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, wears a tiny reporter's cap, and appears only once. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; warm cream background, dark purple (#110518) outlines, chunky sprites and a subtle CRT glow.
